. Alleging that the complaint has not been properly investigated and that the accused is exercising influence over the police authorities, the present petition has been filed seeking the following reliefs:
"1. Issue a writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ/order/direction transferring the investigation of FIR No. 432/2025 registered at PS. Sagarpur, New Delhi, to any other police station of a different district, preferably under supervision of a senior female officer.
2. Direct the Commissioner of Police, Delhi, to constitute a Special team headed by an impartial Investigating Officer not connected with PS. Sagarpur, to carry out the investigation in accordance with law.

5. Pass such other and further orders as may be deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."

Mr. Anand V. Khatri, ASC for State, refutes the allegations levelled by the Petitioner and submits that the investigation has since been concluded and the chargesheet has been filed on 17th November, 2025.
3. In light of the foregoing, the reliefs sought by the Petitioner stand rendered infructuous.
In case the Petitioner has any grievance with respect to the investigation carried out by the State, she shall be at liberty to urge the same before the Trial Court at the appropriate stage.
4. The petition is disposed of along with pending application.
